issues.title: [Architecture] Extensible desktop app registry and typed content schemas
issues.body:
## Goal
Introduce an app registry for existing and future window modules. Define app id, schema version, icon, capabilities, editor, visitor renderer, migrations and mobile fallback. Reuse current window manager (#3) and editing infrastructure (#2); avoid arbitrary third-party executable plugins.

## Scope & acceptance
Acceptance: existing five modules remain compatible; new app registered without modifying unrelated window logic; schema migration and round-trip tests; safe visitor read-only rendering.

## Dependencies
Coordinate with existing #2 (editor/media), #3 (window manager), #4 (history), #5 (mobile) and #7 (security) as applicable.

## Goal
Build OC-focused Instagram.exe atop existing Retro IG MVP (#2): owner can create multiple fictional character profiles with avatar, bio, pronouns/custom fields, theme, handle unique within site, and select account. Separate fictional persona from real owner identity. Support drafts and public visibility.

## Scope & acceptance
Acceptance: two+ OC profiles, switch without content leakage, persisted reload, mobile editor, owner authorization tests.

## Dependencies
Coordinate with existing #2 (editor/media), #3 (window manager), #4 (history), #5 (mobile) and #7 (security) as applicable.

issues.body:
## Goal
Upgrade Instagram.exe visual UI: Win95 chrome with polished responsive profile, grid/list views, multi-image posts, alt text, captions, tags, pinned posts, themed highlights and OC/project collections. Use R2 upload workflow from #2, reuse shared media, accessible keyboard controls.

## Scope & acceptance

## Dependencies
Coordinate with existing #2 (editor/media), #3 (window manager), #4 (history), #5 (mobile) and #7 (security) as applicable.
issues.title: [OC Instagram] Posts, galleries, profile layouts and OC collections

issues.body:
## Goal
Design separate fictional likes/follows/comments (creator-authored worldbuilding) vs real visitor interactions; label simulated stats. Specify permission model for multi-owner collaborative worlds, invites, roles, moderation and abuse prevention before implementation. Phase 1: local fictional interactions only; phase 2: collaboration behind explicit opt-in.

## Scope & acceptance
Acceptance: fictional vs real data never confused, permissions documented, IDOR regression tests, no public user-generated comments without moderation controls.

## Dependencies
Coordinate with existing #2 (editor/media), #3 (window manager), #4 (history), #5 (mobile) and #7 (security) as applicable.

Create Music Player.exe with cover art, track metadata, progress/seek, play/pause, playlist, optional OC theme-song associations, volume, and accessible controls. Start with user-provided permitted audio or external links; do not bundle copyrighted music. Handle autoplay restrictions and mobile.

## Goal
Create Paint.exe-inspired visual composition editor for images, text, stickers and moodboards; not a full raster editor. Reuse R2 uploads and shared document model. Provide move/resize/layer, undo/redo integration (#4), export PNG with safe asset handling.

## Scope & acceptance
Acceptance: create/edit/save/reopen/export; touch-friendly controls; no loss on autosave conflict.

## Dependencies

Build lightweight optional apps: Minesweeper, customizable cat dialog, visitor guestbook and decorative desktop widgets. Separate static decorative content from user-submitted content. Guestbook requires spam/rate-limit, report/delete/moderation, privacy defaults.
